params.text:
Based on the contributor statistics extracted from the AndroidSlidingUpPanel GitLab project, the person who has made the most contributions in terms of number of commits is:

**tokudu** (antonlopyrev@gmail.com) with **150 commits**

This is significantly more than the next highest contributor, Sergii Pechenizkyi, who has 12 commits. The project has a total of 59 contributors, and tokudu's 150 commits represent the vast majority of contributions to the project. The data covers commits to the master branch from May 31, 2013, to September 17, 2017.
